$comment: Smoker picker list. Only entries with verified: true have checked specs; for the rest the app leaves hopper, grate and temp step blank and asks the user to check the manual. Add a source for every spec you fill in.

sources: Pit Boss PB820D3 spec sheet: 849 sq in total, 593 main, 256 secondary, 21 lb hopper, 180-500F (https://assets.ajmadison.com/ajmadison/itemdocs/10514_10693_PB820D3_specsheet.pdf)

Not verified (Jason, 2026-11-17): the temp setting depends on the controller. The PB820SC board is a dial with presets (200, 225, 250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 475, plus Smoke and High; some later units list 180): Pit Boss 820 owner's manual (manualslib 751551) and the PB820SC control board page, given by Jason. The PB820D3 sets 180-500F. No step or preset list is filled in until the picker can ask for the controller (BACKLOG).
Pit Boss Canada, Sportsman 850 with Wi-Fi (PB850SPW2): 849 sq in, 21 lb hopper, 180-500F (https://pitboss-grills.ca/products/sportsman-850-pellet-grill-with-wifi)
Pit Boss, Sportsman 850 product page on pitboss-grills.com (PB850SPW2): 21 lb hopper, 180-500F; given by Jason, 2026-11-16
BBQGuys model 11106: 593 sq in main, 256 sq in secondary (https://www.bbqguys.com/i/3189271/pit-boss/sportsman-850-pellet-grill-w-wifi-11106)

tempStepF 5: seen by Jason on a Sportsman 820 (PB0820SPW) fitted with a controller card that reports PB850SPW2 to Home Assistant, taken to be the Sportsman 850's controller. Pit Boss steps vary by controller board and firmware (owner reports of 5, 10 and 25/50F on the same models, pitbossforum.com threads on PB850PS2 and Pro Series 850 controllers).
